business: SEGMENT: title companies, West Palm Beach
prompt_text: Which title company in West Palm Beach FL is best for a home closing?
answer_verbatim:
There isn’t enough reliable, independent review information here to name one company as definitively “best.” **Integrity Land Title** looks like a solid option to contact: it has a West Palm Beach office and lists residential closings, title searches, title insurance, and escrow services. **Florida Fidelity Title & Escrow** is another local option with a West Palm Beach office and residential settlement services.

Before choosing, ask each for an itemized estimate, who will handle your file, how they protect and verify wire instructions, and whether they can meet your closing timeline. Also confirm your lender approves the company. Florida’s Department of Financial Services says the person paying the title-insurance premium generally gets the first choice of title/closing agent, subject to lender approval. [Integrity Land Title](https://www.integritylandtitle.com/default.aspx?tabid=485) · [Florida Fidelity Title](https://floridatitleco.com/) · [Florida DFS title-insurance guidance](https://www.myfloridacfo.com/division/consumers/understanding-insurance/title-insurance-overview)
